construct: Vancomycin binds the D-alanyl-D-alanine terminus of peptidoglycan precursors, sterically inhibiting cell-wall polymerization and cross-linking in susceptible gram-positive bacteria.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Vancomycin does not bind a bacterial enzyme directly; it binds the D-Ala-D-Ala peptide terminus of nascent peptidoglycan precursors, blocking cell-wall polymerization/cross-linking.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Beta-lactams target PBPs/transpeptidases and can also inhibit peptidoglycan cross-linking, but vancomycin's direct binding target is the substrate D-Ala-D-Ala, not the enzyme active site.
